title: 第11章 盔甲第12章 维斯洛特上
content_zh:
凯撒兴奋地把包裹放在屋外一个相对干净的石墩旁，活动了下发酸的肩膀，几步就跑到那扇木门前。
凯撒推了推，发现门似乎在内部被某些东西挡住了。
随即，他后退一步，猛地一脚踹在门板中央！
“砰！”
一声闷响，门板剧烈晃动，门后堵着的东西似乎松动了，他又补上一脚。
哗啦！
门后一堆倒塌的杂物散落开来，扬起一片灰尘。
凯撒捂着口鼻，等灰尘稍散，才迈步走了进去。
屋内的景象印证了他的猜测，空间明显比普通村民的房子宽敞许多，屋子中央的地面上铺着一张巨大的灰白色兽皮，虽然沾满了血迹，但还能看出原本的价值。
墙上挂着几个狰狞的狼头标本，狼眼空洞，獠牙外露，还有一个巨大的雪鹿头颅。
“好东西果然在这儿！”
凯撒兴奋地喊了一嗓子，目光瞬间就被屋子中央靠墙摆放的一个木架子牢牢吸引住了。
那架子上，赫然挂着一套完整的皮甲，不是普通村民那种只在胸口后背钉几块木片的简陋货色。
这套皮甲的主体是用厚实的兽皮缝制而成，关键部位都镶嵌着打磨过的木片，这些木片用坚韧的兽筋绳牢牢地固定在皮甲上，覆盖面积远超普通村民的木甲。
更难得的是，皮甲的内衬是一层厚实的白色皮毛，看着像是雪鹿腹部的绒毛，保暖性绝对一流。
“好东西！”
凯撒小心翼翼地取下架子上的这套皮木复合甲，入手沉甸甸的很有分量。
他抖落掉上面的灰尘，然后套在自己身上。
将皮甲内侧有简单的皮带扣系好，一股厚实紧密的包裹感立刻传来，隔绝了部分寒气。
凯撒活动了一下肩膀和手臂，坚硬的木片相互摩擦，但防护面积让他安全感大增。

“冷兵器……！”
凯撒忍不住感叹出声，那感觉简直无法形容。
随后，他的目光又扫向架子旁边，那里靠着墙立着几根长矛。
他走过去挨个拿起来掂量，大多都是简陋的木矛，矛头绑着磨尖的骨头或石头。
凯撒很快挑中了一根不同的，这根矛的矛杆依旧是硬木，但矛头却是用铁块制作。
虽然打磨得并不锋利，而且铁条与木杆的连接处是用某种坚韧的兽皮条反复缠绕固定的，显得非常原始和笨重，但它是铁的，这可比骨头和石头强太多了！
凯撒握着这柄沉甸甸的铁矛，用力挥舞了两下，虽然简陋，但比他之前那根简直是鸟枪换炮，安全感再次提升一个等级。
如今食物和装备有了着落，凯撒的心放下了一大半，他开始更仔细地搜索这间屋子。
翻找倒塌的柜子，查看墙角的箱子，大多是空的或者装着些不值钱的杂物。
content_en:
Caesar excitedly placed the package next to a relatively clean stone pier outside the house, stretched his aching shoulders, and ran to the wooden door in a few steps.
Caesar pushed it open and found that the door seemed to be blocked by something on the inside.
Immediately, he took a step back and kicked hard in the center of the door!
"Bang!"
There was a muffled sound, and the door panel shook violently. The blockage behind the door seemed to be loose, so he added another kick.
Wow!
A pile of collapsed debris behind the door spread out, raising a cloud of dust.
Caesar covered his mouth and nose and waited for the dust to disperse before stepping in.
The scene inside the house confirmed his guess. The space was obviously much larger than that of ordinary villagers' houses. There was a huge gray-white animal skin spread on the ground in the center of the house. Although it was stained with blood, its original value could still be seen.
There are several ferocious wolf head specimens hanging on the wall, with hollow eyes and exposed fangs, as well as a huge snow deer head.
"The good stuff is indeed here!"
Caesar shouted excitedly, and his eyes were instantly attracted to a wooden shelf placed against the wall in the center of the room.
On that shelf, there was a complete set of leather armor hanging. It was not a simple thing like ordinary villagers who just nailed a few pieces of wood on the chest and back.
The main body of this set of leather armor is sewn with thick animal skin, and key parts are inlaid with polished wood chips. These wood chips are firmly fixed on the leather armor with tough animal sinew ropes, covering an area far larger than the wooden armor of ordinary villagers.
What's even more rare is that the leather armor is lined with a thick layer of white fur, which looks like the down on the belly of a snow deer, and its warmth retention is absolutely top-notch.
"Good stuff!"
Caesar carefully took down the leather-wood composite armor from the shelf, and it was heavy and heavy.
He shook the dust off and put it on himself.
Fasten the simple belt buckle on the inside of the leather armor, and a thick and tight wrapping feeling immediately comes, blocking out part of the cold air.
Caesar moved his shoulders and arms. The hard wood pieces rubbed against each other, but the protective area greatly increased his sense of security.
"Cold weapon...!"
Caesar couldn't help but sigh, the feeling was simply indescribable.
Then, his eyes swept to the side of the shelf, where there were several spears standing against the wall.
He walked over and picked them up one by one to weigh them. Most of them were simple wooden spears with sharpened bones or stones tied to the spearheads.
Caesar quickly picked a different one. The shaft of this spear was still made of hardwood, but the spearhead was made of iron.
Although it is not polished sharply, and the connection between the iron bar and the wooden pole is fixed repeatedly with some kind of tough animal skin strips, which looks very primitive and heavy, but it is made of iron, which is much stronger than bones and stones!
Caesar held this heavy iron spear and waved it hard twice. Although it was simple, it was like a shotgun for a cannon compared to his previous one, and the sense of security was once again improved to a higher level.
Now that the food and equipment were in place, Caesar felt relieved, and he began to search the room more carefully.
He rummaged through the collapsed cabinets and checked the boxes in the corners. Most of them were empty or contained some worthless miscellaneous items.
